author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಾವರಿಸೆ ಘಟನೆಗಳ ಸುಖಿಯೊನೀ ಜೀವನದಿ
ಆವರಿಸೆ ಬಿಡಬೇಡ ಭಾವ ವಿಸ್ಮೃತಿಯ
ಹಾವಭಾವದಿ ತೋರೆ ಮನದ ಹೊಯ್ದಾಟಗಳ
ಹೇವರಿಕೆ ನಿನಬದುಕು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you calm yourself through events, you will be happy in life;
do not let forgetfulness of feeling cover you;
if you show your inner turmoil in gestures and expressions,
your life becomes distasteful, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Stay calm through events and life is happy. Don’t become numb to feeling, but don’t let inner turmoil spill into how you behave.
